# Lab 12.12: Import & Export Models

## What We Are Going to Do
Import an ONNX model trained outside BigQuery, export a BigQuery ML model to Cloud Storage, and register a model in Vertex AI Model Registry.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Import an ONNX model.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.iris_onnx
OPTIONS (model_type = 'ONNX', model_path = 'gs://cloud-samples-data/bigquery/ml/onnx/pipeline_rf.onnx');

SELECT * FROM ML.PREDICT(MODEL lab12.iris_onnx,
  (SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.ml_datasets.iris` LIMIT 10));</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Export a BigQuery ML model.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">export BUCKET=$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs
bq extract -m lab12.income_bt gs://$BUCKET/models/income_bt
gcloud storage ls -r gs://$BUCKET/models/income_bt | head</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Boosted tree models export as XGBoost Booster files; linear, DNN and k-means export as TensorFlow SavedModels.

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">EXPORT MODEL lab12.penguins_lr OPTIONS (URI = 'gs://YOUR_BUCKET/models/penguins_lr');</span>

4. **[SQL] Register a model in Vertex AI.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab12.income_lr_registered
OPTIONS (
  model_type = 'LOGISTIC_REG',
  input_label_cols = ['income_bracket'],
  model_registry = 'VERTEX_AI',
  vertex_ai_model_id = 'income_classifier',
  vertex_ai_model_version_aliases = ['experimental']
) AS SELECT * FROM lab12.v_income;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Find it in Vertex AI.** Open **Vertex AI → Model Registry**. `income_classifier` is listed with source **BigQuery**. From there it can be deployed to an endpoint for online predictions.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Import | ONNX, TensorFlow, TF Lite, XGBoost |
| Export | To Cloud Storage |
| Registry | Model listed in Vertex AI |
| Online serving | Deploy from Vertex AI |
